channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: These Handstitched Sweaters Are an Old-New Paradox (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Sashiko Gals' handstitched Loopwheeler sweaters are art inside and out, garments as considerately crafted as the sewing that makes them unique.

item.title: Nike Dressed the Air Force 1 In Shockingly Coy Camouflage
item.description: The Air Force One suits classic colorways, but the Nike Air Force One QS Camo reminds us that its power is not limited to monochrome.

item.title: An Understated Louis Vuitton? Groundbreaking
item.description: Louis Vuitton Fall/Winter 2026 is a new kind of Louis Vuitton, rich with understated menswear representative of modern luxury.

item.title: Those Denim Levi's Jordan 3s Are Going to the Super Bowl (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Jordan Brand's Levi's football cleats are going to the Super Bowl, as our first-look imagery of the washed denim shoes reveals.

item.title: Nike’s Most Stylish Running Shoe Goes Full HOKA-Mode In All Black
item.description: Nike’s Vomero Plus Black/Anthracite is an all-black, HOKA-reminiscent version of its most stylish running shoe.

item.title: Nike ACG's Fluffy Olympic Mountain Fleece Is Beautifully Literal
item.description: You're gonna wanna wear Team USA's Nike ACG Olympic fleece way up in the mountains & down in the valley.

item.title: This Reversible Military Backpack Is Marc Newson's Perfect Bag
item.description: Marc Newsom's PORTER bag collaborations may not be what you expect from the legendary designer. Take this backpack, Newsom's idealized daily bag, as proof.

item.title: Junya Watanabe Pulled Stüssy Into a Fin de Siècle Fantasy
item.description: Junya Watanabe & Stüssy debuted another collaboration at Watanabe's 2026 menswear runway show. This time, the duo designed even more clothes.

item.title: Who Knew Trading Cards Could Be Fashion?
item.description: 424's Azuki collaboration hints at a growing familiarity between fashion & trading-card games, as TCG hype begins to take on valuable vitality.

item.title: The New Dior Man Is Hardly as Kooky as He Seems (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Jonathan Anderson's Dior Homme is as crazy as you want it to be. In rare up-close imagery, we investigate the giant cargo shorts & gilded sneakers.
